## Homepage editorial redesign

- Rebuilds Chinese and English home pages as an evidence-led editorial portfolio.
- Adds one accessible project-stage interaction with static and mobile fallbacks.
- Reuses privacy-reviewed classroom, trading and CareRing evidence.
- Preserves all routes, canonical metadata, truth boundaries and public contact paths.
- Keeps the legacy motion layer on project and resume pages while isolating it from the new home pages.
